ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approximately 90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels represent approximately 10% of the area, concentrated on distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity focal spots are mapped to the far distal tips of both lobes. Fine-grained high-intensity pixel groupings are mapped to the peaks of the trailing edge serrations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate interior angle of 45 degrees between the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude variations; the linear boundary consists of irregular, jagged peaks and deep valleys across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the anterior edge; trailing edge displays a wide divergent sweep with a highly irregular, saw-toothed geometric path.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast circular white pixel patterns localized on the outer margins of both the left and right distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extremely irregular, non-symmetrical trailing edge margins featuring deep, macro-level indentations particularly on the right lobe.
